ko: 빛으로 오셨네 온 세상 구주 나셨네
en: Love has come to us, trapped in the darkness, He came as the light, born the Savior of the world

ko: 사랑이 오셨네 온 세상 구주 나셨네
en: To be with us until the end of the age,
Love has come, the Savior of the world is born
Glory in the highest, peace on earth The songs of the angels Now become my song
Shouting on this earth Love has come God with us, Emmanuel
